name: Finland: Part II package and CTIS upload check
applies_to: each Finland package (fi, sv) as a whole (plan-level checklist step)

items.check: K1 recruitment arrangements present on the EU template v2.0, with a section for every population pathway in the plan.
K2 recruitment material present for every advertisement, invitation and communication, with transcripts or storyboards instead of audio or video files.
One L1 information and consent set per population whose population set is triggered.
The recruitment and informed-consent procedure is uploaded under Subject information and informed consent procedure (same file as K1).
Every population that follows a different information or signature pathway has its own documents.
GDPR Articles 12 to 14 information present, in the information sheet or a separate notice or annex.
Planned Finnish sites, principal investigators (name and position) and planned participant numbers entered in CTIS.
For every principal investigator: M1 CV and M2 declaration of interest on the EU templates.
N1 site suitability statement for every site (or one document with the sites clearly separated).
O1 description of the insurance or other guarantee present.
P2 trial financing and site payments description present.
P1 compensation statement present, stating explicitly when no payment is offered.
P3 description of other sponsor-site agreements present.
Fimea invoicing details provided in the CTIS Proof of payment section.
R1 EU data-protection compliance statement completed in the CTIS Form section.
S1 biological-sample compliance statement present (No selected when no samples are collected).
Separate future-use information sheet and consent form present.
Other patient-facing forms placed in Part I per Tukija (or Part II if the CTIS structure requires it).
Recruitment and consent materials (K1, K2, L documents, procedure) are in Finnish and/or Swedish.
Administrative documents are in Finnish, Swedish or English.
Swedish participant documents prepared for Swedish-speaking participants, corresponding to the approved Finnish version; submitted in CTIS only where decided (DECISIONS.md D2).
Documents in a language each participant understands and interpreter support throughout the trial are planned.
No dossier document has been signed merely for submission.
Version numbers and dates agree across the protocol, PIS, ICF and recruitment materials.
Compensation amounts and conditions identical in P1 and every participant document.
Insurance arrangement identical in O1 and every participant document.
Funding, site payments and financial interests identical in P2 and the participant documents.
Sample types, storage, transfers and retention identical in S1, the protocol and the participant documents.
Consent pathways in K1 match the L1 sets in the package.
Documents adapted from the reference package contain all Finnish national content and no leftovers from the reference country.
items.applies_when: Finland is not the reference package

items.check: The Swedish package matches the Finnish package document for document and version for version.
Correct B–S section prefix and CTIS placeholder for each document (the invoicing details and the R1 statement in the CTIS Forms section as recorded).

Unique, self-explanatory title of at most 100 characters: <section code>_<document type>_<subtype>_<country>_<language>_<special attribute>, with only the fields that distinguish the document; _FI_fi or _FI_sv where the language distinguishes it.
Version and date entered in CTIS metadata, not in the title.
Personal names only where disclosure permits (principal investigator in M1/M2).
Clean, tracked-change, redacted or public and split-file variants clearly distinguished.
Uploaded filename base contains none of ( ) / , . ; | [ ] (the period before the extension is fine).
Documents are PDF or PDF/A.
Article 11 workaround: every mandatory Part II placeholder holds the official placeholder PDF titled Part_II_placeholder_document_Article_11_workaround.
items.applies_when: Finland receives Part I only under Article 11

items.check: For each document, publication status checked against the current Annex I publication tables (EMA/263067/2023 revised rules; ACT EU guidance v2.2, 30 April 2026).

Personal data intended for publication removed or protected according to current CTIS transparency rules; public version redacts only qualifying material, irreversibly and unsearchably; author metadata removed; signatures never disclosed.
CCI redaction only after both tests: not in the public domain, and disclosure would undermine a legitimate economic interest.
Public and assessment versions differ only by the intended redactions; each in the correct CTIS slot.
No personal data or CCI in public structured fields.
No drafting instruction remains in any document (see content/conventions/template-instructions.md).
Every document approved by the owner in TrialAgents, or the user has explicitly chosen to export unapproved versions.
